text:
Tess Nguyen: follow-up from the postmortem: we have 4 cleanup tasks left: 1) triage runbook needs safe-checks, 2) escalation matrix is stale, 3) recurrence tagging + dashboard, 4) add tiny eval in PRs. need owners + due dates.
Marco Silva: I can pick up the triage runbook edits (include safe checks + explicit idempotent ops). target: Thu EOD.
Yara Haddad: I'll update the escalation matrix and add a short diagram mapping which teams to page at each severity. target: next Tue.
Tess Nguyen: perfect. who can do recurrence tagging + the small grafana tile?
Marco Silva: I can do a quick saved query too if needed, but i'd prefer Yara or SRE to own the dashboard.
Yara Haddad: ok i'll own recurrence tagging in the tracker and the playbook section. will create saved filter and dashboard tile. target: Mon.
Tess Nguyen: thanks. open question: do we change paging windows for p95 alerts? We saw multiple transient spikes.
sre-oncall: propose increasing the transient window from 5m -> 8m for p95 alerts and adding a pre-page validation step: "verify spike not from scheduled/backfill jobs". we'll test in staging first.
Marco Silva: for runbook snippets i'll add these safe commands (idempotent + dry-run):
```
# check p95 latency for model
rwinfctl metrics tail --model=chat-main --window=5m --stat=p95 | jq '.p95'
# dry-run routing swap
rwinfctl router set-route --route=chat-main --model=chat-fallback --weight=100 --dry-run
# apply route swap when confirmed
rwinfctl router set-route --route=chat-main --model=chat-fallback --weight=100
```
Yara Haddad: recurrence tagging plan: add label recurrence=yes and recurrence_count int. saved filter: "recurrence:yes AND created>=-30d". I'll add grafana tile "recurring_incidents_last_30d" and link it in the playbook.
remedy-bot: created TASK-9001 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TASK-9001) "Runbook & playbook edits from 2005018190 incident" assigned to Marco, Yara. Due dates set per thread.
Tess Nguyen: please paste the doc paths here so I can link in the postmortem tracker and add an eval in each PR for MTTI before vs after.
Marco Silva: triage runbook path: docs/runbooks/triage/latency-safe-checks.md
Yara Haddad: escalation + paging: docs/runbooks/escalation/paging-matrix-2020.md and playbook recurrence section: docs/playbooks/recurrence/recurrence-ops.md
Tess Nguyen: great — once PRs are open drop links and include the tiny eval plan and test steps. i'll close TASK-9001 after merges and a one-week MTTI check. thanks :tada:
Marco Silva: will include "confirm steady-state for 60s" before any rollback and keep steps copy-paste ready. opening draft PR today.
Yara Haddad: draft PRs incoming for escalation + recurrence. calendar invite set for a biweekly "recurrence review" sync.
sre-oncall: will stage threshold change and report results. will add dashboard tile and link it in the PR.
Tess Nguyen: perfect. circling back next week to verify MTTI metrics. appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
